- Marissa (Contracts & Legal Ops) will manage the redline review and return a markup against our standard Redwood MSA within 3 business days.

- Jonas (Sales Ops) will assemble the signer matrix and confirm billing/contact points for the Order Form.

3) Any non-standard IP or indemnity requests we should expect.

Thanks, everyone — quick answers below and apologies for the short delay.

- Signer: Nora Patel, VP Legal (nora.patel@cloudbridge.com) will execute the MSA and Order Form on Cloudbridge's side.
- Subcontractors/hosting: We will be using AWS (us-west-2) as primary; occasional analytics processing in GCP (us-east1). No EU-only residency requirements for initial deploy; EU regions are optional for future expansion.
- Indemnity/Cap: We prefer a mutual cap tied to annual fees; Nora indicates Cloudbridge is open to Redwood's standard cap but requests a good-faith discussion on any specific carve-outs.
- Timeline: Procurement can review counter-redlines within 48 hours of receiving your marked draft.
